clauses.why: Verse 21 gives only the harp playing; 'in the service before the ark of God' is not in it.
Verse 24 says he was a doorkeeper for the ark; 'appointed' and 'as it was brought up' are not stated there.
clauses.english: was a doorkeeper for the ark

clauses.why: The lot is mentioned in verses 13-14, so the citation must be widened; the 'house of Asuppim' is a name the translations render as a common noun, so it is left out.
clauses.english: received the south gate by lot
clauses.deu: erhielt durch das Los das südliche Tor
clauses.spa: recibió por suerte la puerta del sur
